title: Read SR10.4 application-default resources for GtkEntry selection evidence

reference.transport: Read-only Telnet to the authorized assistant clone

method.operation: Read each file with cat and retain matching lines for selection, highlight, XmText, TextField, foreground, background, and color terms. No guest file was written.
method.initial_attempt: An initial client matcher timed out at the login prompt before sending credentials or a guest command; the read-only query was corrected and completed.

findings.meaning: No matching selection/text-field resource in this application-default file.

matching_lines: Lines 15 and 18 are comments about color resources and the Style Manager's secondary color set.
findings.meaning: The active match is a Style Manager color-set selector; it does not define XmTextField selection colors.

matching_lines: Line 1 sets the secondary color set ID to 5.
Line 2 sets XmpIcon pixmapForeground to black.
findings.meaning: These are Vuefile/XmpIcon resources, not XmTextField selection resources.

matching_lines: Most color and selection-related matches are commented examples.
The active matches are an mwm_bw black-and-white Mwm profile, unrelated to the current VUE Find Files text field.
findings.meaning: Do not use the unrelated Mwm profile as a VUE text-selection color rule.

result.claim_limit: This bounds only the four application-default files read. It does not rule out Motif compiled defaults, inherited resources outside these files, or other SR10.4 runtime behavior.

next: Continue I167/GTK2 only. Obtain a visible native VUE selected/unselected pair or bound that comparison without substituting an assumption; then close remaining GTK2 delivery/reload checks.
